key_insight: MedGame turns static clinical cases into structured, decision-driven storytelling games using large language models to support more engaging medical learning.
clinical_relevance: This approach may help medical learners practice case reasoning in a more interactive format than traditional text-only question answering or feedback.
method: Medical Narrative Designer generates case-grounded storylines with states and decision points.
Story Director converts narratives into dependency-aware multimodal orchestration plans for an interactive platform.
A 5,000-case benchmark, MedGame Bench, was created to evaluate medical narrative generation and story direction.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that task-specific fine-tuning improves open-source LLM performance on MedGame Bench, narrows the gap with commercial models, and a pilot student study found the system more engaging and useful than text-only alternatives.
watch_item: The pilot evidence is early-stage, so real-world educational impact, generalizability, and safe deployment in diverse curricula still need validation.
paper_title: MedGame: Storytelling Gamification Empowered by Large Language Models for Medical Education
